- Serum albumin 1.8 g/dL — severely low, consistent with urinary protein loss exceeding hepatic synthetic capacity

- Anti-PLA2R antibody titer — definitive serologic test for primary membranous nephropathy  
- Renal ultrasound — to assess kidney size, echogenicity, and exclude obstruction or structural disease  
- Urine microscopy — to evaluate for cellular casts (e.g., fatty casts support nephrosis; RBC casts suggest GN)  
- eGFR calculation — required to stage CKD and contextualize creatinine elevation

Membranous nephropathy
